scope: Steady-window summary-statistic comparison across distinct absolute integration windows; not same-window convergence or a numerical error budget.
comparison_rule: Compare complete 480-turn steady windows using the existing V9 per-metric thresholds. Preserve absolute time intervals and phase diagnostics; do not align samples or infer a convergence epsilon.

initial_state_provenance.comparison_note: A saved initial state changes the branch start; all final-window metrics are compared as steady statistics.

comparisons.time_window_explanation: Different absolute integration intervals are not aligned samples and are not treated as a numerical refinement. The same-window flag is retained only as a diagnostic; summary statistics are compared under existing V9 metric tolerances after both 480-turn windows pass stationarity.
